bio: Macdonald Bath Spa Hotel offers a hidden haven of beauty and timeless excellence in the heart of historic Bath.  The hotel overlooks stunning landscape gardens and offers a first-class experience in superb surroundings. The private landscape gardens and sensuous spa are just a few of the luxurious features that make the Bath Hotel & Spa ideal for a tranquil getaway in the glorious English countryside.  The Drawing Room is quintessentially English - offering a selection of Afternoon Teas and exquisite Champagne Teas in a luxury venue. Settle into one of the comfortable sofas and take in the glorious scenery, with views of the gardens complementing each sip of fine tea.
